diagnostic_protocol.gpu_time_note: Wall time includes synchronized GPU work, CPU sampling and artifact preparation; not exclusive GPU kernel time
diagnostic_protocol.memory_note: Process CUDA high-water mark; not reset, so may include earlier training
diagnostic_protocol.catalog: Sorted unique nonzero real IDs in training histories; embedding bounds checked
diagnostic_protocol.competitors: Catalog minus original observed prefix, target and padding; other full-history positives remain eligible
diagnostic_protocol.target: Included exactly once, including repeat targets; absent catalog targets are protocol errors
diagnostic_protocol.ranking: Descending actual FP32 score, ascending item ID for exact ties; no tie tolerance
diagnostic_protocol.sampling: Uniform n=min(99,C) unique competitors without replacement
diagnostic_protocol.popularity: Training interaction counts; descending count then ascending item ID; boundaries ceil(V/3), ceil(2V/3)
diagnostic_protocol.aggregation: Anonymous prefix means, no user-bootstrap intervals; duplicate rows retained and counted
diagnostic_protocol.limits: Training fit includes memorization and sampler weighting. Eligibility differs from host and simulator. Expected sampling gaps alone are not defects. No generalization, preference, compatibility, diversity or causal claims.

metric_definitions.correctness_audit: Measured FP32 padding, causal alignment, empty-history, batch-state, ModelView/module and state-dict roundtrip checks; failure raises. Generated writer and routing parity remain unverified.
metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: (Mean off-diagonal cosine+1)/2 over up to 2048 nonzero-norm sampled item embeddings excluding padding. Directional concentration, not recommendation diversity; null with insufficient support.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean positive-minus-negative score over aligned nonzero input, positive and negative training positions; null without support.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank lower tenth percentile of valid training margins; null without support.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid training margins strictly below zero.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid training margins below 0.5.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Valid-position and low/wrong-margin counts. Item categories are unavailable, so category lists are empty.
metric_definitions.diagnostic_protocol: Measured execution details and fixed training-only population; no supplied training iterator or explicit training generator is consumed.

catalog_competition.rank: Exact training-catalog target rank 1+M; M counts C eligible competitors preceding target under declared tie rules.
catalog_competition.full_diagnostic_hit: Indicator M<=9 on the declared training-catalog population; not host validation HR@10.
catalog_competition.expected_sampled_diagnostic_hit: P(X<=9), X~Hypergeometric(C,M,min(99,C)); C=0 gives one. Analytic conditional probability, not an observed benchmark hit.
catalog_competition.expected_sampled_hit_full_miss: P(X<=9)*1[M>=10]; its prefix mean equals expected sampled-hit rate minus full diagnostic-hit rate. Expected sampling behavior, not evidence of a defect.
catalog_competition.target_minus_tenth_competitor: Target score minus tenth competitor score; null with fewer than ten competitors. Exact ties require item-ID ordering to determine hits.
catalog_competition.rank_distribution: Complete empirical rank counts over completed finite prefixes; duplicate sampled prefixes retained.
catalog_competition.joint_strata: Training item-rank popularity thirds crossed with observed length, repeat-target status and actual sampled candidate count; descriptive prefix means with support, no user intervals.
catalog_competition.counts: Visited/skipped/protocol-error/nonfinite/duplicate prefixes and unfinished batches. Nonfinite scores invalidate the entire prefix, never individual competitors.
catalog_competition.chunk_parity: Measured bounded comparison of candidate scoring with different chunk shapes; does not establish cross-platform bitwise reproducibility.
